name: P07 #1 — ADULT SHOTS: one look at each grown character in the P07 demo, so the doll problem is looked at and not argued about.

steps.note: S1. the whole cast, on one grid, lit and posed. This is the frame the gap is really about.
S2. Barty alone, close, walking — the smallest adult and the clearest doll
S3. the same framing on Halvard, who is the one the canon calls a man
S4. the boy, the same way — the proportion every adult is measured against
S5. farmer and innkeeper — the two villager bodies most in shot in a town
